events.title: New Progression Screen & Job Tree Now Live!
events.summary: The latest update (v042) introduces a job tree and overall progress tracking. It’s now easier than ever to see what you need to focus on to unlock new jobs and complete your map objectives!

events.title: Demo & Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Dear Wishlisters,I’m super excited to share that the long wait is finally coming to an end! Tribes of the Ridge is getting closer to launch, and the very first date you’ll want to mark on your calendar is October 1, 2026 for the official Demo Release. To make October even bigger, the game will also be participating in Steam Next Fest from October 19–26, 2026. events.title: Reason for delaying the release of the game
events.summary: Dear Wishlisters, I am really sorry to make you all wait this long for the release. There is a problem with the release as I (the developer) have joined a gamedev company and thus it is now a bit tricky for me to release the game under my name. It's a purely bureaucratic problem. Sorry to all the players and let me ensure you that once this problem is solved (which depends on my company's guidlines), the game will be released asap.
